steps.caption: Option 6B · Search with content. ⌘K searches titles and the text inside pages.
A half-remembered phrase is enough: the page, and the line that matched, words in bold.
Enter opens the page scrolled to that paragraph, lit for a moment.
Results group by type, with counts; title matches first, then text, newest first.
Chips filter by type, project or “edited this week”. The index stays fresh on every save.
